title: Airflow Compensation and Sensitivity Change for the Cargo Compartment Smoke Detection Loops
abstract: Cancelled proposal to re-tune the cargo smoke detection loops with an airflow compensation term, abandoned when the sensor supplier withdrew the compensating variant and the false alarm rate fell for unrelated reasons.

sections.reason: Cargo compartment smoke detection false alarms were running at 0.9 events per 1000 flight hours, above the 0.3 target, and were concentrated on aircraft operating from dusty airfields. Analysis of 60 events showed that most were triggered during descent, when the compartment ventilation flow changes rapidly and lifts settled dust past the sampling head. The proposal was to add an airflow compensation term to the detection threshold so that the loop discounts a rapid obscuration change that coincides with a ventilation transient.
sections.description: The proposal replaced the sensor assembly D2610128987481 with a variant carrying a differential pressure tapping, added the actuator assembly D2610121268620 to modulate the sampling flow, and re-ported the sub-assembly valve D2610128911453 so that the sampling head sees a stable flow through the descent. The detection duct FIN 3WF7 was to be re-clipped clear of the new tapping. Work would have been done from inside the aft cargo compartment in zones 131, 134 and 143. Drawings D26101223994 issue E and D26101239117 issue F were released to issue and then withdrawn.
sections.effects: Had it been embodied, the change would have added 2.4 kg per aircraft and 18 VA of electrical load, and would have required a re-demonstration of the detection response time against the certification requirement. It was cancelled in 2017 after the sensor supplier withdrew the compensating variant from its catalogue, and after a revision to the cargo compartment cleaning task cut the false alarm rate to 0.25 events per 1000 flight hours without any hardware change. No aircraft was modified and no bulletin was issued. The drawings were withdrawn but the cancelled proposal remains on file because parts of the airflow analysis are still cited by later cabin work.
sections.embodiment_note: Cancelled before any embodiment. No production cut-in, no retrofit bulletin, no spares provisioning. The record is retained for the airflow analysis it contains.
